description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'ExampleAppWidgetConfigure' that provides a configuration screen for an app widget, allowing users to set a prefix that is saved in SharedPreferences and used to update the widget.

classes.name: ExampleAppWidgetConfigure
classes.description: Activity class handling the configuration UI for an app widget, managing user input for the widget's prefix and storing preferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, retrieves widget ID from intent extras, and loads existing preferences.

methods.name: mOnClickListener
methods.description: Handles the save button click, saves the prefix preference, updates the widget, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: saveTitlePref
methods.description: Saves the widget's prefix text into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: loadTitlePref
methods.description: Loads the widget's prefix text from SharedPreferences or returns a default string if not set.

methods.name: deleteTitlePref
methods.description: Intended to delete stored preferences for a widget but currently unimplemented.

methods.name: loadAllTitlePrefs
methods.description: Designed to load preferences for multiple widgets but currently unimplemented.
